comments.author: Mia Schulz (Sales)
comments.body: What we promised our loyal customers: 10% off for everyone who has been a customer for more than 2 years.

comments.author: Jonas Becker (Finance)
comments.body: I'd rather not tie this to how long someone has been a customer: some of our oldest customers hardly buy anything. What about 5% once a customer has paid 3 invoices? Let's settle this before it gets built.
